article.story: LEXINGTON, Va. -- — Rickey Bradley’s 27 points helped VMI defeat Southern Indiana 87-83 in overtime on Tuesday. Josh Smith grabbed his own offensive rebound, was fouled and hit both free throws just before the buzzer in regulation to make it 73-all and force overtime. Bradley shot 8 of 16 from the field and 9 of 11 from the free-throw line for the Keydets (5-3). T.J. Johnson added 17 points and three steals while going 4 of 15 from the floor, including 4 for 14 from 3-point range, and 5 for 6 from the foul line. Alexander Daushvili had 13 points and shot 5 for 11 (0 for 4 from 3-point range) and 3 of 4 from the free-throw line. Donovan Hunter led the Screaming Eagles (2-6) in scoring, finishing with 18 points and three steals. Josh Smith added 13 points and eight rebounds for Southern Indiana. Fredy-Salam Sylla also had 13 points and seven rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
